title: Closeout and Contain
description: A defender closes out hard on a catch, then must contain whatever the ball handler does next without fouling or giving up an easy middle drive.

content.objective: Close out under control and then contain whatever the shooter decides to do next.
content.setup: A defender starts in a help position as a shooter catches on the wing.
instructions: The defender pushes hard to close out, braking to a controlled stop on the last stroke.
If the shooter attacks, the defender contains by sliding, not lunging.
If the shooter holds, the defender contests the shot with a high hand, staying square.
Rotate the shooter's decision randomly across reps.
coachingPoints: Brake under control on the approach so the closeout lands balanced.
Stay square on the contest — turning sideways gives up the drive.
Keep the hands active without fouling.
commonMistakes: Closing out too fast and losing control of the chair on arrival.
Squaring up late and letting the shooter attack before the defender is set.
Turning the chair to face the direction of travel instead of staying square.
content.safety: Contest with a high hand only; no reaching across the shooter's body.
